Native-safe AnimatedNumber reproduces the web rAF ease-out-quad (1-(1-p)^2) count-up from 0 to value over duration*1000ms with tabular-nums, jumping to the final value under OS reduce-motion; cleanup cancels the pending frame on unmount so no timer dangles under --detectOpenHandles. Native-safe WidgetShell covers exactly the props the call site uses (title/icon/loading/error/updatedAt/isFetching/isStale/isError/onRefresh/children): Skeleton (testID 'skeleton') while loading, an inline danger AppText block (testID 'widget-error', unused by this widget) on error, a titled header (icon + uppercase muted caption title + freshness) or a title-less overlay freshness chip. DataFreshness is a Pressable(onRefresh) status dot+label whose relative time is computed once at render (no 30s interval).

No DOM elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, react-dom, or web UI-kit modules are imported into the native output — only React, RN primitives (View/ScrollView/Pressable/StyleSheet/AccessibilityInfo), the shared apps/native AppText/SemanticIcon/tokens, the native parity EmptyState/Skeleton, and the native parity useProjectedRange/useVehicles/useSettings hooks. Verified: `npm run typecheck` (exit 0), `npm run lint -- --quiet` (exit 0), and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` (45 suites / 272 tests pass, exit 0) including the added __tests__/ProjectedRangeWidget.test.tsx covering the standard comparison+badge layout, the wide Range Factors list, the compact title-less big-number+badge, the no-data EmptyState, the loading Skeleton shell, the errored-query EmptyState + 'Error' freshness dot, the freshness->refetch press, the imperial (mi) distance conversion, and the vehicle-id resolution (first-vehicle fallback + explicit prop precedence).
